english_name: Sunset Reappears II: Fire Dragon Client Edition
english_description: Another build of Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon by AKAI Studio, in the same family as xysylmhb (Sunset III: Fire Dragon Edition), and likewise using the old Tomud client handshake protocol. As with xysylmhb, its map actually belongs to the unrelated "Tianya" family rather than the true Sunset Reappears lineage — another case in this collection where the title's branding doesn't match the underlying code's true origin.
